package.name: gim6010_driver
package.description: ROS-independent SocketCAN driver for SteadyWin GIM6010-8/GDS68 motors: CAN Simple (axis state, controller mode, position/velocity/torque setpoints, limits, gains, telemetry, error handling) and MIT motion control encode/decode, plus multi-bus/multi-motor routing. Depends on nothing beyond a Linux SocketCAN-capable kernel and the C++ standard library, so it is reusable outside the Quattro workspace by any project driving this motor family.
